sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic/lexical paper (gesture-to-sign, numerals, mouthing, ASL independence). Footnote 1 (p.244): 'Analytical issues involving phonology (handedness, hand shape, location, movement, etc.), morphology and syntax are addressed elsewhere in Orie (2012).' Only mention of 'accent'/'tone' is the Yoruba (spoken) orthography key in fn. 2.
